tasks.short: Talk with the client about progress, review progress against the care plan goals, evaluate it, record progress notes, and update the goals.

steps.what: Hospital social worker talks with the client about progress
Hospital social worker reviews client progress against measurable goals in the care plan
Hospital social worker evaluates client progress
Hospital social worker records client progress notes

loop.input: The social worker's spoken summary after the talk and the care plan goals.
loop.output: Draft progress notes per goal in the record's format.
loop.check: A validator flags every risk statement and every goal without a note; the social worker reads, corrects and approves.
loop.stop: One draft per contact; if the social worker rejects it, they write the notes.
loop.why_not_simpler: Dictation alone gives a transcript, not notes per goal.

steps.what: Hospital social worker updates the care plan goals

tasks.design: The patient record ({OTHER}) shows each care plan goal with its latest score and notes, so progress is reviewed on one screen instead of reading back through notes. After a talk, the social worker speaks a short summary and a bounded step drafts notes per goal; a validator flags risk statements and goals without a note, and the social worker corrects and approves. Talking with the client and judging progress stay with the social worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress had to be read from free-text notes, and notes were typed after each talk.
tasks.enabler_now: Records show goal status; speech tools draft notes in Dutch care records.
tasks.still_hard: Psychosocial progress is hard to score.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that a patient who says all is fine is not coping.
tasks.altitude: The social worker checks drafted notes instead of typing them.

evidence.claim: Attendi turns spoken notes into a SOEP report or letter in the care record.
UK social workers found invented suicidal ideation in AI-drafted notes.
Recording staff conversations needs works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the care plan to goals updated; treatment decisions are outside.
Input contract: goals in the record; fallback is free-text notes.
The social worker approves every note.
research_questions: How often does the validator flag a statement the social worker did not say?

already_counted.description: Hospital social worker reads and corrects drafted notes.

incremental.description: Hospital social worker scores goals after each contact.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few contacts per client; high: a large caseload with frequent contacts.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review the patient record, interview the patient and family, identify environmental impediments to progress, and note them in the record.

steps.what: Hospital social worker reviews patient records for social circumstances
Hospital social worker interviews the patient and family
Hospital social worker identifies environmental impediments to patient progress
Hospital social worker notes the impediments in the record

tasks.design: The record ({OTHER}) gets a social summary view with living situation, informal carers, income and earlier social work contacts, so the social worker does not page through admission notes. Impediments go into structured fields (housing, care at home, finances, language) that other staff can see. Interviewing and identifying impediments stay with the social worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Social information was spread through free-text notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Patient records can show structured social fields in a summary view.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing that the stairs at home, not the illness, will keep a patient in hospital.

reach.learn: Whether home impediments are known early.

evidence.claim: Patient records can hold structured social fields in a summary view.
Health data are special category data under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: Boundary: from the referral to impediments noted; solving them is outside.
Input contract: social fields filled at admission; fallback is reading notes.
Interviewing and judging do not change.
research_questions: Are home impediments found earlier in the stay?

incremental.description: Hospital social worker fills the structured social fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: short stays with simple situations; high: long stays with complex histories.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel clients and patients in individual sessions, lead group sessions, plan group sessions and invite participants, and note the sessions.

steps.what: Hospital social worker counsels patients in individual sessions to help them adjust to life
Hospital social worker plans group sessions and invites participants by phone
Hospital social worker leads group sessions to help patients overcome dependencies and recover from illness
Hospital social worker notes the sessions in the record

tasks.design: Group sessions are set as a recurring series in the hospital agenda ({CALENDAR}) and participants get text reminders, so the social worker phones fewer people. Session notes use a short template per session type in the record ({OTHER}). Counselling individuals and leading groups stay with the social worker; sessions are not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participants were invited and reminded by phone and notes were free text.
tasks.enabler_now: Hospital agendas send text reminders for series.
tasks.still_hard: Patients in crisis miss sessions whatever the reminder.
tasks.human_edge: Holding a group together when one member breaks down.

evidence.claim: Hospital agendas can run session series with text reminders.

assumptions: Boundary: from the counselling need to sessions noted; referral to therapy is outside.
Input contract: patients' phone numbers in the record; fallback is phoning.
Patients read reminders; no added patient time.

incremental.description: Hospital social worker keeps the group participant list current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly individual sessions; high: many group sessions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess home situation and care needs, find available home care or nursing home places, coordinate with family and care providers, write the discharge plan and referral, check it with the patient and family, send the referral, and arrange aids and transport.

steps.what: Hospital social worker assesses the home situation and care needs
Hospital social worker phones care providers for available places
Hospital social worker coordinates with family and care providers
Hospital social worker plans discharge from the care facility in the transfer form
Hospital social worker checks the final plan with the patient and family
Hospital social worker e-mails the referral to the receiving care provider
Hospital social worker arranges aids and transport by phone

tasks.design: A regional capacity overview ({PARTNER_PORTAL}) shows free home care and nursing home places, so the social worker phones only the likely providers. The transfer form fills from the record with diagnoses, medication and care needs. Once the patient and family agree, the referral goes to the receiving provider through the secure exchange, and aids are ordered on the supplier's portal. Assessing needs, coordinating with family and agreeing the plan stay with the social worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Places were found by phoning round and transfer forms typed from the record.
tasks.enabler_now: Regional capacity overviews and secure transfer exchanges exist between hospitals and care providers.
tasks.still_hard: Places are scarce whatever the overview shows.
tasks.human_edge: Helping a family accept that their mother cannot go home.

evidence.claim: iStandaarden (iWmo, iJw) carry messages between municipalities and care providers.
Health data are special category data under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: Boundary: from discharge expected to aids arranged; the move itself is outside.
Input contract: providers keep capacity current; fallback is phoning round.
Assessing and agreeing do not change.
Providers read referrals as before; no added provider time.
research_questions: Do days waiting for a place fall?

incremental.description: Hospital social worker checks the prefilled transfer form.

approvals.approved_version: The plan as agreed with the patient and family in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: discharges home without care; high: many transfers to nursing homes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The hospital social worker keeps counselling, interviewing, judging progress and planning discharges with families; typed notes, phone rounds and retyped forms shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A social worker with more time for patients and families.
